catalysts.headline: FutureFuel reported Q3 2026 results: revenue $104.7M (+361.3% YoY from $22.7M), GAAP net loss $8.4M (-$0.19/share) vs a $9.2M loss a year earlier; Biofuels revenue rose to $87.8M from $7.1M but posted a $9.8M gross loss on record-high soybean-oil/fat feedstock costs plus $8.7M of net derivative losses; Chemicals revenue rose to $16.9M from $15.6M despite a 27% volume decline from customer turnarounds; booked orders for over 90% of Q4 2026 biodiesel production capacity; guided to positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4 2026 and for full-year 2026; management outlined a plan to rebuild cash to $50M over the next year
catalysts.impact: Large revenue beat/jump alongside a continued net loss; stock fell sharply after the print

catalysts.headline: FutureFuel Q3 2026 results: revenue $104.7M (up from $22.7M in Q3 2025); net loss $8.4M (-$0.19/diluted share) vs $9.2M loss a year earlier; Biofuel segment posted a $9.8M gross loss on elevated feedstock costs and $8.7M in derivative losses despite record production/sales volumes and higher utilization; Chemicals segment revenue grew from capacity expansions despite maintenance-driven volume declines; management said orders booked through early November covered >90% of Q4 biodiesel production capacity and guided to ~$7M of Q4 adjusted EBITDA; plan outlined to rebuild cash to $50M over the next year
